h.strategy: Before writing hypotheses, decide which field values typically appear in strong configurations and which in weak ones. A condition that fixes such a value mostly selects strong (or weak) parents. Use this deliberately. Strong parents have little room left, so edits that usually help gain less there, and edits that usually hurt lose more. Weak parents sit near a floor, so harmful edits cost little and helpful edits gain a lot. Write at least six hypotheses where this quality effect predicts the opposite direction to the most obvious story about how the parts connect. Write the remaining ones on the strongest effects you are confident in. Use only conditions that many parents satisfy. Spread hypotheses across edited fields and edit values. In each 'why', name the quality mechanism.

hyps.why: A parent with edge 0 removed is a weak, low-capacity cell near the floor, so adding a strong conv on edge 5 gains much more than in already strong parents.
A conv3x3 on edge 3 marks a strong parent with little headroom, so the usual gain from upgrading edge 0 is smaller.
A parent with edge 5 already removed is weak and near the floor, so removing edge 4 as well costs little extra accuracy.
Strong parents with a conv3x3 on edge 3 have more accuracy to lose, so switching edge 1 to a weak pooling op hurts more.
A strong parent with a conv3x3 on edge 0 is already near its ceiling, so the modest benefit of a skip on edge 2 is mostly absent.
A weak parent with edge 5 removed lacks a good direct path to the output, so adding a skip on edge 3 gains a lot from a low base.
A strong parent sits high on the accuracy scale, so removing a key output edge costs more absolute accuracy than in weak parents, despite the redundancy from edge 3.
Replacing a removed edge (a weak, floor-level parent) with a conv gains much more than replacing an existing op in a stronger parent.
A parent with pooling on edge 1 is already weak and near the floor, so removing edge 0 costs little compared to stronger parents.
A strong parent with a conv3x3 on edge 5 is saturated, so an extra conv3x3 on edge 2 adds less than it does in weaker parents.
